metadata.source: FWC Unified Reef Map Level 1, source records attributed to Biscayne Bay FWC/NPS
metadata.geometry_policy: Original mapped source polygons are preserved individually. No dissolve, clustering, gap filling, or invented named-flat boundary is performed.
limitations: Source-map footprints are coverage extents, not ecological bay boundaries.
Mapped Tidal Flats class does not establish present-day substrate, exposure, accessibility, or fish suitability.
A patch outside the FDEP Biscayne Bay Aquatic Preserve is not thereby outside the ecological bay.
Source mapping dates vary by project and must be retained for any later temporal analysis.
